scene: The robot panda hums, popping open its brass chest to reveal gadgets.
picture: Flat side view on the plank walkway. On the left, the mechanical panda sits with its brass chest flap wide open, displaying ticking cogs. In its mechanical paw at centre rests a glowing neon bamboo shoot. The player stands facing it on white roller skates in her red jacket. Far right, the rope bridge sways.
